name: .204 Cal-48gr Hammer Hunter®
note: Recommended use: Varmint hunting. The product page also says: "This is a long .204 caliber bullet designed to extend the effective range of the caliber. It requires a 1-8″ twist rate to properly stabilize. If you have the twist to handle this bullet it would be a great choice for long range doggin’." The product name says 48 gr; the specification says 48.7 gr.
